title: Clicking an object on another layer doesn't make that layer active (Flash auto-switch)
description:
USER-REPORTED. In Flash 8, clicking a selectable object with the Selection (arrow) tool makes that object's LAYER the active/current layer. In our editor, clicking an object that lives on a non-active layer neither selects it nor switches the active layer.

REPRO (:1420, Selection tool):
- Two-layer doc: Layer A (top, index 0) active and EMPTY; Layer B (bottom, index 1) holds one object at stage center.
- setActiveLayer(0) so A is active; click the object on B at stage center.
- OBSERVED (e2e via __flashTest bridge, HEAD 65dd1e0): activeBefore=0, activeAfter=0, selection=[] for objType=instance AND objType=text. Active layer stays A and the object is not even selected. Vector-shape case (subselection path) behaves the same by code inspection (couldn't screenshot-verify because the hand-built scratch shape crashed render — orthogonal fixture issue; the code path is unambiguous).

SCOPE / selection types:
- Symbol instances + static text -> standard select path (StageArea.tsx onShapeSelect -> Shell.handleShapeSelectFromStage).
- Vector shapes -> subselection path (partialSelectEnabled always-on for Selection tool; StageArea.tsx:2620 routes to onSubSelect and RETURNS before onShapeSelect). Tie-in to tasks 1331/1361 (the planar subselection cutover): a SubSelection is just { shapeId, keys } and carries NO layer info, so even a future select->layer hook on that path has no layer to read without resolving shapeId back to its owning layer.

ROOT CAUSE (two coupled defects):
1) HIT-TEST IS SINGLE-LAYER. The selectable display-object lists fed to StageArea are built ONLY from the active layer:
   - packages/authoring-ui/src/Shell.tsx:2448-2463 -- shapeDisplayObjects/textDisplayObjects/symbolInstanceDisplayObjects = *DisplayObjectsAt(timeline, safeActiveLayerIndex, currentFrame).
   - packages/authoring-ui/src/selectors/derived.ts:39-60 -- displayObjectsOfType()/shapeDisplayObjectsAt() filter to activeKeyframeForLayer(timeline, layerIndex, frame) -- a SINGLE layer.
   So an object on a non-active layer is not in the hit-test arrays at all. In StageArea.tsx pointer-down (~2602-2725) the hit tests over shapeDisplayObjects/symbolInstanceDisplayObjects/textDisplayObjects miss, and the click falls through to the empty-stage marquee branch (StageArea.tsx:2716 onShapeSelect(null)) -> deselect. (The full multi-layer SceneGraph at Shell.tsx:2471 fullSceneGraph is RENDER-only; it is not used for hit-testing.)
2) NO ACTIVE-LAYER-ON-SELECT WIRING. Even within the active layer, selecting an object never updates the active layer. Shell.tsx:1130 handleShapeSelectFromStage and Shell.tsx:1144 handleShapeSelectMultiple only call setSelectedShapeIds([...]); neither calls setActiveLayerIndex. The vector path (StageArea.tsx:2620 -> onSubSelect=setSubSelection) also does not. The active layer lives in uiStore (activeLayerIndex/setActiveLayerIndex, threaded through Shell.tsx:815; safeActiveLayerIndex clamp at Shell.tsx:1008). So there is currently NO code that sets the active layer on object select on ANY path.

FLASH NUANCE (for a correct fix):
- Flash makes the clicked SELECTABLE object's layer the active layer. It will NOT switch to a layer you cannot select objects on: LOCKED layers, HIDDEN layers, and GUIDE/MASK guide layers (their contents are not directly selectable on stage). So: switch the active layer to the hit object's owning layer ONLY when that layer is selectable (visible && !locked && type allows stage selection); skip locked/hidden/guide. Hit-testing must likewise honor visible/locked (don't select objects on locked or hidden layers).

FIX DIRECTION:
- Make stage hit-testing span ALL eligible layers (visible && !locked, excluding guide/mask-guide for direct selection), top-to-bottom, instead of only the active layer. The cleanest approach: have the hit-test resolve the owning layer index for the hit object.
- On a successful object select (all paths: standard onShapeSelect, marquee onShapeSelectMultiple, and the vector subselection onSubSelect), set the active layer to the hit object's owning layer via setActiveLayerIndex, gated on the layer being selectable (visible/!locked/!guide). For the subselection path, resolve shapeId -> owning layer (SubSelection carries no layer) -- ties to the 1331/1361 rerouting.
- Respect locked/hidden/guide both for selectability AND for the auto-switch target.

VERIFICATION: e2e on :1420 -- two-layer doc, active=A(empty,top), object on B(bottom); click it -> getActiveLayerIndex()==B's index AND object selected; assert NO switch when B is locked or hidden. Cover instance, text, and vector-shape (subselection) object types.

Priority MEDIUM (editor UX / Flash-parity, user-reported).
